judge.reason: The memo targets the review queue, integration conflicts, WIP caps, scope cuts, and the critical path. It labels its forecasts as uncalibrated scenarios and explicitly declines to derive a P85. It rejects the eight-agent proposal on Brooks and bottleneck grounds, keeps regression checks (tiering or fixing them instead of halving), and lists decisions needing the user's authorization without invoking any one-third-timeline cutoff.
